warnings.warning: The Summary calls the forecast and revenue horizon 50 years, but the ABM starts in 2006 and the tables extend to 2070, a 64-year interval.
The article says southern and western coasts lose herring within 20 years, while the baseline mean points to about 2051 and only the upper case is near 2038.

The Summary and article cite roughly $42 million herring revenue, while the baseline body and Appendix A2 report a Shetland maximum around $44 million; Table 3 uses $42.18 million for a selected north site.
The Summary/body present three solutions, while the public article presents four by splitting transition to mackerel from harvesting haddock.
The Summary reports refrigeration gains from about 43% to over 1700%, while the article says 50% to over 1700%.
The Scotland Region is defined as N50-N60, but a 64-row 0.25-degree grid, Figure 3, Python extent, and Appendix sites use N50-N66 or reach N63.75.
A 0.25-degree cell is described as having area about 27.75 km2, but 27.75 km is approximately the north-south side length; area is much larger and longitude width varies with latitude.
Strong annual oscillation is visible in Figure 2, yet the paper says residuals have no high-level structure without displaying residual diagnostics and then omits seasonality.
Independent cell regressions have no holdout test, uncertainty band, spatial regularization, or climate-forcing scenario for extrapolation to 2070.
Scottish landings are treated as total accessible herring abundance even though removals are not a stock census.
1.525e8 herring divided by 20,000 per school is about 7,625 schools, rounded to 8,000 without an uncertainty rationale.
1.875e8 mackerel divided by the Figure 7 value of 20,000 per school is about 9,375 schools, not the 4,000 agents used in prose and code.
Equating path velocity directly to the negative thermal-distance gradient omits a movement-rate coefficient, coordinate metric, units, and boundary conditions.
Equation 6 merely states R(t)=<x(t),y(t),0> after saying the component equations are integrated; no solution, initial condition, or numerical integration is supplied.
The prose calls the discrete neighbor logic equivalent to the continuous gradient equations without quantifying discretization, scaling, or tie behavior.
A one-third-patch move often leaves a turtle on its previous patch, so the subsequent prev-patch equality can trigger escape mode even after a valid directed step.
Escape mode is described as lasting at most 10 days, while code sets random 30, producing values from 0 through 29 days.
The death counter never resets when temperature returns below tolerance, so exposure is cumulative rather than seven consecutive days.
Code kills only when death-counter > death-time, so with death-time 7 a school dies after the eighth counted hot day.
Printed setup-fish values are mackerel defaults only; the paper does not show a complete, reproducible herring parameter switch.
Equation 7 uses annual landed tonnage per vessel as if it were physical per-trip vessel capacity.
The prose first states 1,070 tonnes but Equation 7 uses 1,079 tonnes.
Equation 8 prints 45 kg - 40 kg even though the text says a 45 kg filled net and 5 kg net; the claimed 5.7% requires 40 kg of fish, or 45-5.
One 5.7% catch proportion cannot arise identically for both species when fish mass and vessel fish capacity differ unless the weight-level formulation is shown consistently.
The displayed currency conversion and annual value/tonnage inputs do not transparently reproduce the rounded $0.50 mackerel price, and no herring price result is printed.
The company loop treats each turtle as a school but the visible code has no school fish-count state or catch depletion, permitting repeated daily revenue from persistent agents.
The PDF physically clips the core trip-revenue and capacity expressions, so the printed harvest calculation cannot be executed or fully audited.
last-catch is updated whenever any turtle is in radius, not when a positive capacity-feasible catch is actually made.
Only three stochastic runs per one of 87 sites are averaged, with no seeds, variance, intervals, or convergence criterion.
Disappearance times are right-censored at 2070 but averaged as ordinary values; many mackerel sites equal the cutoff.
start-offset=25*365 does not represent Jan. 1, 2006 from Jan. 1, 1982; the exact interval is 24 years plus leap days.
The until-2070 target 32141-start-offset conflicts with table maxima of 23,375 days and omits an explicit exact-date convention.
Adding or subtracting 1.96 times measurement error to every historical observation does not by itself define a 95% confidence interval for future climate trend or a best/worst scenario.
Herring upper/lower differences are called significant without stochastic intervals or a statistical test.
Ports that never receive a fish may retain last-catch=0, mixing never-accessed sites with immediate disappearance and contributing to the reversed mackerel mean.
The herring baseline 16,584 days after Jan. 1, 2006 is around mid-2051, yet body text says around 2052 and the conclusion says 2056.
Relocation uses four fixed illustrative ports and gross revenue curves rather than optimizing a feasible relocation path or deducting the cited $400,000 cost.
Haddock output maps are shown without the temperature, depth, population, price, catch, mortality, or code parameters needed to reproduce them.
At 4 knots, five days of continuous travel is far greater than 51 km; the independent 51 km source radius is simply tripled for refrigeration without a closed speed/time/range calculation.
Table 3 calls values rounded to the nearest $100,000 but prints values such as $8,895,798 and inconsistent lower-order precision.
Revenue is repeatedly called profit or benefit although relocation, refrigeration, fuel, labor, permits, gear, maintenance, quota, discounting, and risk are omitted.
The article says Iceland and Greenland have free reign to reduce Scotland's quota, while the body only supports a conditional shift in management influence and possible overestimate.
The territorial-water analysis checks distance from proposed ports but not whether vessel routes to migrating fish cross foreign territorial seas or require EEZ access.
The strengths section calls the stochastic sample size large even though reported decisions use only three repeats per site.
The strengths section gives coordinate examples N20,S20 and N20,S30, which are not valid latitude-longitude pairs for Scotland.
The conclusion gives a 2070 regional range of 8-12 C while the reported regional mean is 12.05 C, which cannot exceed the stated maximum range.
The conclusion recommends haddock as a profit-restoring strategy despite absent net-cost and gear-transition calculations.
NetLogo arrays are explicitly truncated for presentation and multiple statements/comments run beyond the PDF right edge.
Python download URLs and several NetCDF/plot expressions are physically clipped, so the acquisition and fitting script is incomplete.
The printed Python code creates lower and upper SST arrays but the shown T_regs fitting block loads and fits only the baseline file; scenario refitting requires undocumented manual changes.
The forecast plot maps 31,879 evenly spaced samples to 1982-2070 while evaluating only 13,879+18,000 days, short of the actual calendar interval.
